$comment: The human layer's vocabulary. Seven strands, each a question every country in the set already answers in its own words — because the same twenty-seven categories are written for every country, which is what makes 'the same door, twenty-two countries' possible at all. This is deliberately not lenses.json: a lens is what a country *leads on* and is used to filter a map; a strand is a thread of storytelling and every country has all seven. Nothing here names a country, and no strand invents a subject — each one points at categories that are already written.

$schema.title: the word on the door
$schema.asks: the question the door answers, in the second person
$schema.line: one sentence of context, about the strand and not about any country
$schema.categories: which of the twenty-seven write-ups belong behind this door, in order

people.title: People
people.line: Africa is not one people. It is roughly two thousand languages, and the answer changes at every border and often inside one.

culture.title: Culture
culture.asks: What is kept, and who keeps it?
culture.line: Kingdoms that still hold court, festivals with a date and a place, and practices that belong to particular communities rather than to a continent.

food.title: Food
food.line: Not a cuisine. Fifty-four of them, argued over, regional inside every country, and mostly cooked at home.

craft.title: Craft
craft.line: Work with a technique, a lineage and a place it is made — bronze, cloth, beadwork, clay — and usually a market you can buy it in from the person who made it.

cities.title: Cities
cities.asks: What is it like to live here?
cities.line: Most Africans live in cities and most visitors fly over them. Markets, transport, music, nightlife and the ordinary weekday.

heritage.title: Heritage
heritage.line: What was built, what was survived, and what is deliberately kept — including the parts that are difficult to stand in front of.

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.asks: What does a visit do to this place?
responsibility.line: Who holds the permit, where the money lands, and who is employed. Stated where an operator has said it, and left blank where nobody has.
